name: Pandi's Aim Trainer
desc:
Welcome to Pandi's Aim Trainer! 🐼

[In case you encounter a bug, have suggestions or see a cheater on the leaderboard, please let us know by writing feedback!]

Controller & Mobile support has been added!

Controls:
R - Start/Restart Scenario
G - End Scenario

Want to improve your aim? Then this is the right place for you! A Great Aim Trainer made to help improve your aiming skills and make you one of the best players in games such as Rivals, Arsenal and Bad Business. 🎯💪
(A WIP experience inspired by Aimbeast & KovaaK's)
